candidate_schedulers.codegen_rationale: The scheduler prioritizes critical (high-criticality) nodes first, ensuring they are allocated if they fit within available resources. For low-criticality (agent) nodes, it reserves CPU headroom (1 core) to prevent contention and ensure that critical tasks have dedicated CPU resources, reducing deadline misses. This implements the 'branch_critical_headroom' advice to reserve CPU headroom for critical releases before admitting low-criticality agent nodes.

candidate_schedulers.codegen_rationale: Implements a two-phase scheduling algorithm: critical nodes are scheduled first in criticality order, then agent nodes are scheduled in starvation-boost order (longest waiting agents first, with a configurable waiting time threshold to boost priority). This balances critical deadline protection with fairness to agent tasks that may be starved if critical tasks dominate resources.
